newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse ends session 0.27 pct higher.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse ends session 0.27 pct higher.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Thursday closed up by 0.27 percent in higher but still thin trade, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 456.08 points, up from 454.84 on Wednesday.
Total volume was 407,872 dinars against 375,780 dinars over the previous session.
Beer bottler SFBT fell 1.5 dinar to 81.5 dinars. Chemical firm Alkimia was down 1.22 dinar to 39.56 dinars. Retail stores Monoprix eased 0.8 dinar to 31.2.
UBCI bank won 1.28 dinar to 44.14 dinars. Amen Bank was up 0.9 dinar to 30.9. Banque de l'Habitat rose 0.43 dinar to 14.97 dinars. BTEI bank advanced 0.26 dinar to 22 dinars.

Airline Tunis Air was up 0.1 dinar to 22.7 dinars. Tunis Air on Thursday announced that it will distibute a 2.79 dinar dividend per old share on its results of 1996, higher than 2.52 dinar per share in 1995. ($1=1.095 dinar)
